source_documents.title: Insight into the strong aggregation-induced emission of low-conjugated racemic C6-unsubstituted tetrahydropyrimidines through crystal-structure-property relationship of polymorphs

reference_evidence_units.quote: THPs 1–3 in different organic solvents (cyclohexane, ethanol and acetonitrile etc.) are practically non-emissive
reference_evidence_units.subject: THP 1 (series statement)
reference_evidence_units.statement: Non-emissive in solution, emissive as crystalline polymorphs.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Owing to intramolecular motions (the rotation of single C–C and C–N bonds and the
reference_evidence_units.subject: THP 1 (series statement)
reference_evidence_units.statement: Large knr in solution from single-bond rotations and flipping of the central ring.

reference_evidence_units.quote: because of the restriction of intramolecular motion (RIM) by intra- and intermolecular interactions, and their kr values increase to 0.41–1.03
reference_evidence_units.subject: THP 1 (series statement)
reference_evidence_units.statement: On aggregation knr falls (to 0.05-3.48 × 10^8 s-1) and kr rises (to 0.41-1.03 × 10^8 s-1).
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Rates for the series; per-polymorph values in Table 1.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Although 1–3 are poorly conjugated, the radiative rate constants (kr) of their polymorphs are as large as conventional fluorophores
reference_evidence_units.subject: THP 1 (series statement)
reference_evidence_units.statement: Large kr is explained by through-bond and through-space conjugation in the packed conformations.

reference_evidence_units.quote: which means that both a local excitation state (LE) and an intramolecular charge transfer excitation state (ICT) exist.
reference_evidence_units.subject: THP 1 (series statement)
reference_evidence_units.statement: HOMO/LUMO separation suggests mixed LE/ICT states.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Orbital picture only; computed for compound 1 polymorphs.

reference_evidence_units.quote: intramolecular motion but also from enhanced electronic coupling and radiatively-favored inter-crossed local excitation (LE) and intramolecular charge transfer (ICT) excitation states.
reference_evidence_units.subject: THP 1 (series statement)
reference_evidence_units.statement: AIE = RIM plus enhanced electronic coupling and radiatively favoured LE/ICT states.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: THP 1: single-bond rotations and ring flipping give large knr in solution; their restriction in the polymorphs lowers knr.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Mixed LE/ICT excited states, from orbital distributions only, are part of the radiative argument.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: THP 1: the paper separates kr and knr and explains the strong solid emission equally by a raised kr from through-bond/through-space conjugation in the packed conformation.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: THP 1: single-bond rotations and ring flipping give large knr in solution; their restriction in the polymorphs lowers knr.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Mixed LE/ICT excited states, from orbital distributions only, are part of the radiative argument.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Not discussed for this molecule in the source.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The through-space conjugation is between the two carboxylates of the same molecule; packing changes the conformation, not an intermolecular coupling. Not labelled.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: THP 1: the paper separates kr and knr and explains the strong solid emission equally by a raised kr from through-bond/through-space conjugation in the packed conformation.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Single-exponential fluorescence decays; no triplet discussion (THP 3 carries Br but no heavy-atom effect is discussed).

environment_context: RS vs RR/SS packing modes set the conformation and through-space conjugation

contrast_group.varied_factor: ester alkyl (1: ethyl vs 2: methyl) and N-aryl para-Br (2 vs 3)
contrast_group.paper_difference: Same mechanism for the series; emission differences are traced to polymorph packing, not to the substituent.

evidence: SI (Chem. Sci. ESI, s001): THP 1 = diethyl 1,2,3,6-tetrahydro-1,2,3-triphenylpyrimidine-4,5-dicarboxylate (R1 = Et, R2 = H); OPSIN parse of that name has the same InChIKey as the case SMILES

reannotation.note: RADIATIVE raised from secondary to co_primary: the abstract gives the raised kr as half of the AIE explanation.
